title: Wave 2 — classify multi-host upgrades with empty requiredRegions
purpose: Propose action for each multi-host upgrade that had empty requiredRegions (exclude Herb patches N). Info-only — does not edit catalog.

actions.remove_all: Drop the upgrade from every region host (global/skip/not region-planning-relevant).
actions.primary:<regionId>: Keep a single home region; set requiredRegions=[home]; remove foreign host copies.
actions.multi-ok: Intentional multi-host; keep listed hosts and set requiredRegions to the multi set (see reason).
actions.wall: Ambiguous — needs human ruling before apply.

sources: live multi-host empty-req scan during session (pre-collapse hosts)
policy: Exclude Herb patches (N) per-region rows — already local-home with requiredRegions=[self].
Prefer explicit user rulings from 2026-07-26 foreign-upgrade pass over detail-text heuristics.
hosts[] is the multi-host empty-req problem snapshot, not necessarily live host set after concurrent collapses.
Do not invent numbers or quest localities beyond existing detail + prior rulings.
